profile.headline: SWE @ Roblox

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Led the redesign of a critical service processing over 1.4 million monthly reports with duplicate detection. 

My project exceeded its initial scope, expanding from impacting three report types to all, resulting in significant cost savings of over $105K monthly by mitigating potential SLA violations.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · DynamoDB · Apache Spark · Apache Airflow · Amazon S3 · Amazon Elastic MapReduce (EMR) · Java · Amazon SQS · AWS Lambda

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Shipped the first-ever cross-platform First Time User Experience (FTUX) in Roblox,  revolutionizing immersive onboarding by launching a universal tutorial customization interface.

It currently sits at the top of the homepage for Roblox QuestVR, amassing over 1M impressions within the first few days of Beta release with an overwhelmingly positive 94% like ratio.
positions.insights: Skills: AR/VR · C++ · OpenXR · React · Redux · Lua

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Pioneered a model for the latest AWS AMI migration, leveraging cloud automation (IaC) to proactively safeguard against security vulnerabilities.

This approach effectively mitigated potential losses of over $148,000 while significantly reducing the time cost of provisioning developer infrastructure by 96%.
positions.insights: Skills: Terraform · Python · Linux · Boto3 · Ansible · Docker · Jenkins · Bash · Packer · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Kubernetes

positions.title: Mobile Software Developer Intern - META Lab
positions.description:
Developed an innovative cross-platform mobile app from the ground up, designed to track habits and promote mindfulness. 

This app is currently being used at the forefront of groundbreaking research being conducted at META Lab, garnering over 500+ downloads in Appstore.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Firebase · Dart · Git · Kotlin · Figma · Flutter · Android Studio

company.name: East Side Union High School District
